t: The Essentials 600mm curved glass cooker hood is made from stainless steel with a height-adjustable design, push-button controls for straightforward use, and quiet operation. Features BLDC technology to provide efficient extraction and recirculation of cooking fumes and odours, with three speed settings and a powerful 409m³/hr extraction rate. Requires CARBFLT150 carbon cooker hood filter (175VV - sold separately). Ideal for modern kitchen installations.
